positions.title: Research And Development Intern
positions.description:
- Worked on the project ”Sharing Docker Images across hosts on Veritas distributed file system”.
- Conducting research to enable distributed daemons to collaboratively retrieve and store container images in shared storage and create containers from the shared images.
- Phase 1: To make OverlayFS(Linux) compatible with Veritas Cluster file system (VxFS) for supporting docker’s overlay2 storage driver.
- Phase 2: Design and develop a middleware that helps in sharing the read-only layers of a docker image with distributed daemons.
- Experienced first hand pioneer industry research.
